criteria.text: The response identifies that Distribution Agreement Section 10.1 requires Taisund to indemnify Stepisk for product-related claims even where they are caused by a defect in the Products, and that Section 12.2 removes Section 10 indemnity obligations from the Section 12.1 liability cap, so that Taisund's exposure for such claims is uncapped. It locates the issue in the Distribution Agreement (Sections 10.1 and 12.2), explains why this matters to Taisund, and recommends a fix.
hints: regardless of whether caused by a defect

criteria.text: The response identifies that Statement of Work Section 9.1 selects New York law and exclusive New York County courts, and that because Distribution Agreement Section 2.3 gives the Statement of Work precedence, this choice overrides the Delaware law and Wilmington forum in Distribution Agreement Section 18 for disputes within the SOW's scope. It locates the issue in SOW Section 9.1, explains why this matters to Taisund, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that Distribution Agreement Section 17.2 allows Stepisk to assign the Agreement without Taisund's consent, and that the October 19, 2026 notice letter shows Stepisk intends to assign it to Orlenne Event Group LLC, a competitor of Taisund in the Territory. It locates the issue in Distribution Agreement Section 17.2, explains why this matters to Taisund, and recommends a fix.
The response states that under Distribution Agreement Section 2.3 the order of precedence is the Statement of Work first, then the Service Level Schedule, then the Distribution Agreement.
The response states that Stepisk's notice letter is dated October 19, 2026.

The response is in the form of a memo addressed to the supervising partner. It presents the issues in an order the response describes as reflecting their importance to the client, and for each issue it gives the location (document and section), why the issue matters, and a recommended fix.
